study_design: Retrospective matched case-control study with an additional qualitative focus-group component
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The quantitative portion consisted of a retrospective, matched case-control study of two hundred and four men attending outpatient clinics who completed an interviewer-administered questionnaire.
reason: The quantitative analysis evaluated prostate cancer generally. References to early-stage diagnosis and outcomes are contextual and do not establish an aggressive incident prostate cancer analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Four risk factors were identified: family history of PCa (OR 3.39, 95% CI 1.73, 6.66), age (OR 1.97, 95% CI 1.41, 2.74), any sexually transmitted disease (STD) history (OR 2.02, 95% CI 1.07, 3.83) and alcohol consumption (OR 1.86, 95% CI 1.00, 3.47).
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol estimate is for prostate cancer overall and has no aggressive endpoint definition.
